title: Journey Plan - today vs proposed (strike what you don't want)
sub: Lab, big demo company (600 shops, 20 salesmen), Sunday. Left of each arrow = the app today. Right = proposed, running in the lab only - nothing proposed is live. Your picks stay: the 160 px map strip and the fold. Gold dashed box = what changes. Section 5 is already built (your "q2 = sure").

sections.h: 1. Owner on the phone (390 px) - the top of the screen

pair.cap: Today. "336 shops left" is 600 - 264, the number just above it, said twice. Find a shop only opens from "ALL ▾". The map starts at 407 px.
Proposed. One line: 20 salesmen out · 0 overdue. A search key beside "ALL ▾". Empty band 46 → 34 px. The map starts at 367 px - 40 px higher.

items.cap: Proposed - one press on the search key. The fold opens and the shop box is ready to type (the keyboard comes up on a real phone).

sections.h: 2. Owner on the phone - the Team box

pair.cap: Today. Two "BS 11/28" (Budi Santoso and Bagus Setiawan) and three "DS" (Dadang, Dede, Dika) - you cannot tell who is who. Top says 264 visited, here 228/588 "shops".
Proposed. When two men share letters, the chip shows the first name: BAGUS, BUDI, DADANG, DEDE, DIKA. Others keep their letters. "228/588 sold" - 264 shops visited, 228 of them bought.

sections.h: 3. Salesman (Dika, tier 6) on the phone - checked for the first time

pair.cap: Today. Dika's first screen shows the whole area: 263/598 visited, 335 shops left, 8 salesmen out. His own next shop is below the map, at the bottom of the Team box - he has to scroll for it.
Proposed. The same one line, but his: YOUR NEXT SHOP WARMED AFGANMART02 · 0,6 KM. An owner or a man with no round today sees salesmen out · overdue instead.

items.cap: Today - where his next shop is now: "Heading to WARMED AFGANMART02", far down the page under the map.

pair.cap: Today. Find a shop is already open on the PC, full names in the Team list. Only the Team header says "228/588 shops" next to "264/600 visited".
Proposed. One word: "228/588 sold". Nothing else moves on the PC (the search key is phone-only).

sections.h: 5. Day Replay - the pressed shop is marked (BUILT, your "q2 = sure")

items.cap: 390 px. You press a shop low on the map (it stood at 562 px). Its card opens over the bottom, so the map moves the shop up to 301 px, above the card - glowing gold with a gold ring under its flag.
Lite Mode. The glow goes, the gold ring stays - you can still see which shop it is.
412 px. This shop was already above the card (348 px, card top 523 px), so the map does not move.

sections.h: 6. Also proposed - no picture, nothing changes in the look
sections.note: (a) Journey Plan opens in 1.8-2.2 s on the big company; 0.32 s of it is the map re-making every shop's icon - reuse them. (b) Demo only: the capybara's "WELCOME BACK, BOSS!" bubble covers the full map's Exit corner on Android - move the bubble.
